Ruth M.: Quick plan: 15m launch livestream to demo the new pricing calculator + test two FAQ variants. narrow, product-led.
Carlos V.: ok. what are we optimizing for? demo bookings or self-serve signups?
Ruth M.: demo bookings from mid-market/enterprise = primary. secondary = more embedded calc starts.
Priya S.: suggest A/B: Variant A = inline calculator + concise FAQ; Variant B = advanced estimator gated (email + company size) + expanded FAQ. 50/50.
ops-bot: routing suggestion -> if email_domain in enterprise_allowlist then tag:enterprise_lead else tag:marketing_inbound
Carlos V.: define enterprise_allowlist: list will include Fortune 500 + target accounts. scoring = domain_match + company_size>500 => SDR.
Priya S.: microcopy: Committed bullets: "Predictable monthly price", "Reserved GPU pools", "SLA & priority support". Metered bullets: "Pay per token", "Burst autoscale", "Cost-saving batching tips". Keep each to 2-3 words for mobile.
Ruth M.: webinar flow: 3m pricing thesis, 7m calc demo (startup vs ingestion), 3m Q&A, 2m CTA to try calc or book demo.
Carlos V.: tracking: UTM=pricing-livestream-2845612345. page CTAs: Try calc (no gate), Advanced estimator (gated). A/B assign param variant=A/B.
Priya S.: iframe snippet for devs:
```
<iframe src="https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-livestream-2845612345&variant=A" width="100%" height="520"></iframe>
```
ops-bot: event created: "pricing-livestream-2845612345" and rule "tag:webinar_inbound" applied to registration leads.
Ruth M.: success metrics: demo conversion >=8%, calc starts +10% vs baseline, gated lead quality +15% (win-rate proxy).
Carlos V.: I'll confirm SDR handoff format by EOD. Priya, can you post FAQ copy in #marketing-summaries Monday AM?
Priya S.: will do. Ruth M.: thanks all :rocket:
